flags.quote: Точность поддержания температуры при +25 °C окружающей среды ±2.2 °C при -41 °C и +25 °C
flags.explanation_uz: Past haroratli muzlatkich uchun ish harorati diapazoni -40...-32 C deb berilgan, ammo aniqlik -41 C da ±2,2 C ko'rsatilgan, ya'ni diapazondan tashqarida. Shovqin darajasi ham ikki tomonlama tor oraliqda (60-61 dB) belgilangan, sovutgich uchun 47-51 dB. Bunday kombinatsiya bitta modelning pasportidan olinganga o'xshaydi va talabga mos boshqa uskunalarni chetlatishi mumkin; hujjatning o'zi mahalliy takliflar texnik talablarga mos kelmaydi deb qayd etgan.
flags.explanation_en: For the low-temperature freezer the operating range is -40 to -32 C, yet accuracy is stated at -41 C, outside that range. Noise is fixed in a two-sided narrow band (60-61 dB, and 47-51 dB for the refrigerator). The combination looks lifted from one model's data sheet and may exclude otherwise suitable devices; the document itself notes that local offers do not match the technical requirements.
flags.rewrite_uz: Harorat bir xilligi va aniqligi: ish diapazonida (-40...-32 C) ±3 C dan oshmasligi; shovqin darajasi: 65 dB(A) dan oshmasligi (sovutgich uchun 55 dB(A) dan oshmasligi).
flags.rewrite_en: Temperature uniformity and accuracy: no worse than ±3 C within the working range (-40 to -32 C); noise level: not above 65 dB(A) (not above 55 dB(A) for the refrigerator).

reasons_uz: Qatnashish mumkin, lekin avval quyidagi shartlar bo'yicha buyurtmachidan tushuntirish so'rang.

Haddan tashqari tor texnik parametrlar (2-bet): Past haroratli muzlatkich uchun ish harorati diapazoni -40...-32 C deb berilgan, ammo aniqlik -41 C da ±2,2 C ko'rsatilgan, ya'ni diapazondan tashqarida. Shovqin darajasi ham ikki tomonlama tor oraliqda (60-61 dB) belgilangan, sovutgich uchun 47-51 dB. Bunday kombinatsiya bitta modelning pasportidan olinganga o'xshaydi va talabga mos boshqa uskunalarni chetlatishi mumkin; hujjatning o'zi mahalliy takliflar texnik talablarga mos kelmaydi deb qayd etgan.

Ishlab chiqaruvchi yoki diler xati talabi (platformadagi mezonlar): Ishlab chiqaruvchi bo'lmagan ishtirokchi uchun zavod avtorizatsiyasi 1 ball beradi, lekin uni topshirmaslik tenderdan chetlatishga olib keladi. Ya'ni 1 ballli mezon amalda majburiy talabga aylangan va 10,66 mlrd so'mlik lotda mustaqil yetkazib beruvchilar chetlashishi mumkin. Servis va kafolat boshqa hujjatlar bilan ham tasdiqlanishi mumkin.
Buyurtmachining so'nggi 251 ta savdosida ishtirokchilar medianasi 2 ta; savdolarning 67% qismida ikki yoki undan kam ishtirokchi; eng ko'p g'olib bo'lgan yetkazib beruvchi ulushi 6%.
reasons_en: Worth bidding, but first ask the customer to clarify the conditions below.

Over-narrow technical parameters (page 2): For the low-temperature freezer the operating range is -40 to -32 C, yet accuracy is stated at -41 C, outside that range. Noise is fixed in a two-sided narrow band (60-61 dB, and 47-51 dB for the refrigerator). The combination looks lifted from one model's data sheet and may exclude otherwise suitable devices; the document itself notes that local offers do not match the technical requirements.

Manufacturer or dealer letter required (platform criteria form): For a bidder that is not the manufacturer, factory authorisation earns 1 point, yet omitting it means exclusion from the tender. The one-point criterion thus acts as a mandatory condition, and independent suppliers on this 10.66 billion UZS lot could be shut out. Service and warranty could also be proved by other documents.
In the customer's last 251 deals the median number of bidders was 2; 67% of deals had two or fewer bidders; the most frequent winner took 6%.
